idea.name: Funding carry (delta-neutral)
idea.blurb: Hyperliquid perps vs spot · collects funding · market-neutral
idea.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto Carry' (BIS WP 1087 / Management Science); Hyperliquid funding docs
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for coins whose 7-day average funding is above 15% a year (up to 6, richest first), buy spot and short the same amount of perp; keep while funding stays above 5%. Price moves cancel, the book earns the funding longs pay shorts.

backtest.caveat: Sharpe is flattered by the smooth hourly premium used as the basis proxy; real risks are tail events (short-squeeze margin calls, venue risk) and a yield that has been shrinking.

idea.name: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Altcoins priced in BTC · trend-following · BTC-hedged, beta ~0
idea.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen, 'Time series momentum' (JFE 2012); Menkhoff et al., 'Currency momentum strategies' (JFE 2012); Liu & Tsyvinski, 'Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency' (RFS 2021)
idea.rule: Daily at 00:00 UTC: for each altcoin, price it in BTC and average the trend sign over 10/20/42/84 days (-1..+1). Long the alt perp when its BTC cross trends up, short when it trends down, sized to 20% vol per cross / 21 alts; the BTC perp takes the opposite of the net alt exposure (market-neutral).

backtest.caveat: Weak edge: the direction calls beat random ones (p=0.03) but the Sharpe interval includes zero and the last two years were flat (Sharpe -0.06). On probation - it earns its place on paper or gets retired. Uses only ~36% of the book gross, so returns are small by design.

idea.name: Vol-managed crypto momentum (market-neutral)
idea.blurb: Weekly winners minus losers · sized by momentum's own recent volatility
idea.source: Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, 'Cryptocurrency momentum has (not) its moments', Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025; Barroso & Santa-Clara, 'Momentum has its moments', JFE 2015
idea.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: rank coins by 30-day return (skip the latest day); long the top fifth, short the bottom fifth, equal weight; scale the book by 20% / its own realised vol over the last 8 weeks (max 2x).

backtest.caveat: On probation. The paper's key claim - that volatility scaling improves crypto momentum - did NOT replicate on our coins (scaled 0.51 vs unscaled 0.66). The winner/loser picks beat random ones only weakly (p=0.07), the Sharpe interval includes zero, and it lost money in 2025 and 2026. Backtest drawdown 42.5% would have tripped this book's 30% kill switch in 2025.

idea.name: Breakout Rocket: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged)
idea.blurb: Nine channel breakouts per coin · trailing stops · 60% vol target, up to 3x
idea.source: Zarattini, Pagani & Barbon, 'Catching Crypto Trends; A Tactical Approach for Bitcoin and Altcoins', SSRN 5209907 (2025): Donchian ensemble over nine horizons, BTC net Sharpe 1.56, CAGR 30%, max DD 19% at a 25% vol target; top-20 rotation ~11%/yr alpha over BTC
idea.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: for each coin run nine breakout systems (5-360 days): long on a close above the prior L-day high, out on a close below the trailing channel midpoint. Signal = share of systems long; size by 1/60-day vol; scale the book to 60%/yr vol, max 3x gross.

backtest.caveat: High risk by design: the backtest lost 71% peak-to-trough (2022 and 2025), had a -22% day, and this book's kill switch only fires at -75%. Coins are today's Hyperliquid survivors, so the long-only result is flattered (dead coins like LUNA are missing). It is 0.83 correlated with Strategy 1 - a leveraged cousin with a different trend engine, not a diversifier. The paper's long/short version did NOT replicate here (Sharpe 0.78, short leg -12%/yr), so it is long-only.

ideas.name: Funding carry (delta-neutral) - Strategy 3
ideas.source: Schmeling, Schrimpf & Todorov, 'Crypto Carry' (BIS WP 1087 / Management Science); Hyperliquid funding docs
ideas.rule: Daily: for coins whose 7-day average funding is above 15%/yr (up to 6), buy spot and short the same amount of perp; keep while funding stays above 5%. Market-neutral, earns the funding longs pay shorts.
ideas.verdict: Promising, now live on its own $10k paper book: out of sample 8.5%/yr, max drawdown 0.16%, beats random coin picks (p=0.005), survives 3x costs; yield has shrunk in 2026 (3.2%/yr) and the Sharpe is flattered by the smooth basis proxy.

ideas.name: Cointegration pairs trading
ideas.source: Fil & Kristoufek, 'Pairs Trading in Cryptocurrency Markets', IEEE Access 8 (2020); Tadi & Kortchemski, Studies in Economics and Finance (2021), https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.10662
ideas.rule: 4h bars: weekly pick 5 disjoint Engle-Granger cointegrated pairs on 60 days; enter |z|>2, exit at 0, stop |z|>4.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -1.99 (CI -3.2 to -0.8, -15%/yr, max DD 32%) Aug 2024-Sep 2026, negative even before costs; 1h version -4.4; all 9 walk-forward configs negative.

ideas.name: Low-volatility long/short (beta-neutral)
ideas.source: Kaya & Mostowfi, 'Low-volatility strategies for highly liquid cryptocurrencies', Finance Research Letters 46 (2022), https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1544612321004116
ideas.rule: Monthly: long lowest-vol third, short highest-vol third (180d vol), legs sized to equal BTC beta.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe -0.35 (CI -1.4 to 0.8), -11%/yr, max DD 75% (2021: -72%) despite strong 2022/2024/2025; tail risk unacceptable.

ideas.name: Intraday momentum (first half of UTC day -> second half)
ideas.source: Shen, Urquhart & Wang, 'Bitcoin intraday time series momentum', Financial Review 57 (2022), https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/fire.12290
ideas.rule: Sign of 00-12 UTC return -> hold 12-24 UTC.
ideas.verdict: Rejected (exploratory): corr +0.10 Mar-Sep 2026 but -0.06 Jun 2024-Mar 2026 on 4h bars; not stable.

ideas.name: Momentum after one-day abnormal returns
ideas.source: Caporale & Plastun, Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 34 (2020), https://ideas.repec.org/a/kap/fmktpm/v34y2020i3d10.1007_s11408-020-00357-1.html
ideas.rule: After a daily return beyond 2 sd of the last 90 days, trade in its direction for 1 day.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: net Sharpe 0.00 (momentum) and -0.38 (contrarian) on 22 coins 2020-2026.

ideas.name: Alt/BTC cross trend (market-neutral) - Strategy 4
ideas.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (JFE 2012); Menkhoff et al. (JFE 2012); Liu & Tsyvinski, RFS 34(6) 2021, https://doi.org/10.1093/rfs/hhaa113
ideas.rule: Daily 00:00 UTC: trend score (10/20/42/84d signs) of each alt priced in BTC; long/short the alt perp at 20% vol per cross / 21, BTC perp offsets net exposure.
ideas.verdict: Live on probation: net Sharpe 0.42 (CI -0.34 to 1.20), 3.3%/yr, max DD 9.7% Nov 2020-Sep 2026, direction beats random (p=0.033), beta ~0, but walk-forward 0.18 and last 2y -0.06.

ideas.name: Time-series factor momentum (4 crypto factors)
ideas.source: Ehsani & Linnainmaa, 'Factor Momentum and the Momentum Factor', Journal of Finance 77(3) 2022, https://www.nber.org/papers/w25551
ideas.rule: Monthly: hold each market-neutral factor (xs momentum, low-vol, alt/BTC trend, xs carry) at 10% vol if its past-12-month return > 0, else flat.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: Sharpe 0.55 (CI -0.36 to 1.39), 7.9%/yr, 25% DD Oct 2021-Sep 2026, worse than holding all four factors (0.68); every factor currently off.

ideas.name: Vol-managed crypto momentum (market-neutral) - Strategy 5
ideas.source: Grobys, Kolari, Sandretto, Shahzad & Aijo, Financial Markets and Portfolio Management 39(4) 2025, https://doi.org/10.1007/s11408-025-00474-9
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: long top fifth / short bottom fifth by 30-day return (skip latest day), equal weight, scaled by 20% / the book's own 8-week realised vol (max 2x).
ideas.verdict: Live on probation: Sharpe 0.51 (CI -0.26 to 1.25), 10.2%/yr, max DD 42.5% Nov 2020-Sep 2026, placebo p=0.066, beta ~0; vol scaling did not beat unscaled (0.66) and the last 2 years lost 11%/yr.

ideas.name: Breakout Rocket: Donchian breakout ensemble (leveraged) - Strategy 6
ideas.rule: Daily: nine breakout systems per coin (5-360 days) - long on a close above the prior L-day high, out below the trailing channel midpoint; size by 1/vol and scale the book to 60%/yr volatility, up to 3x gross.
ideas.verdict: Promising, live at high risk: Sharpe 1.54 (CI 0.68-2.50), 147%/yr, max DD 71% Sep 2020-Sep 2026, beats random direction (p=0.005) and buy-and-hold of the same coins (1.03), survives 3x costs; long/short variant rejected (0.78, short leg -12%/yr); 0.83 correlated with Strategy 1.

ideas.name: Kalshi in-and-out scalper - Strategy 7
ideas.source: Burgi, Deng & Whelan, 'Makers and Takers: The Economics of the Kalshi Prediction Market' (CEPR DP20631, 2025) - https://cepr.org/voxeu/columns/economics-kalshi-prediction-market
ideas.rule: Rest a YES bid 1c inside wide spreads on the most active Kalshi markets, flip it 1c under the ask as soon as the trade tape fills it, bail out as a taker after 2 minutes or a 3c drop; the naive buy-then-sell is measured as a never-traded control.
ideas.verdict: Live forward test (no order-book history to backtest). Naive instant in-and-out measured at -8.1c per contract after fees on the first 95 samples; the maker version has to beat 0 after fees and adverse selection.
